notes.title: v1.18 "Endorsement Reinforcements" Update Now Available
notes.content:
v1.18 "Endorsement Reinforcements" UpdateAdding new Endorsements and Issue


The Political Machine 2024 is a political simulation game that allows players to run their own presidential campaigns, navigate complex political landscapes, and engage with various issues and endorsements. The latest update, version 1.18, titled "Endorsement Reinforcements," introduces a few new features aimed at enhancing the gameplay experience without making sweeping changes to the overall mechanics.
New Endorsements[p align="start"]One of the highlights of this update is the addition of three new endorsements that impact a player's campaign strategy:
[olist]
Tech Billionaire: This endorsement provides a substantial boost of 2 million Funds, which can be critical for funding campaign activities. Additionally, it increases Enthusiasm in all states by 10%. This endorsement reflects the growing influence of technology leaders in modern politics and offers players a strategic advantage in resource allocation.

Former President: Securing the endorsement of a former president can lend considerable credibility to a campaign. This endorsement also raises Enthusiasm in all states by 10% and boosts the Issue Score in all states by 20%. This makes it a valuable asset for candidates looking to solidify their standing on key issues.

World's #1 Podcaster: With the rise of social media and digital platforms, the endorsement of the world's #1 podcaster can have a significant impact. This endorsement increases Enthusiasm in all states by 20%, making it a powerful tool for engaging younger voters and those active on social media.
[/olist]New Issue Added[p align="start"]In addition to the new endorsements, the update introduces a new issue relevant to the current political climate: "Release the Epstein Files." This issue has been added to the top 15 issues in the states of Alaska, Massachusetts, Iowa, and North Carolina. This addition reflects ongoing discussions in real-world politics and offers players a chance to navigate the complexities of public sentiment surrounding sensitive topics. While currently relevant, it was important to keep the relevance of this topic to the context of the 2024 Presidential Election to preserve game balance.
[p align="start"] 
[p align="start"]The "Endorsement Reinforcements" update for The Political Machine 2024 may be small, but it provides players with new strategic options to explore as they campaign for the presidency. With the introduction of impactful endorsements and a timely issue, players can further tailor their approach to resonate with voters in this engaging political simulation. As always, the effectiveness of these new features will depend on how players choose to integrate them into their overall campaign strategies.

notes.title: v1.17 'Tariff Update' Now Available

In addition to the new event, we've made essential updates to state demographics and party registration data. These updates incorporate the latest findings from the 2024 election exit polls and results, ensuring that the game accurately reflects the current political climate. By aligning the game data with real-world statistics, we aim to provide a more immersive experience for players as they navigate their political journeys.

We are committed to continuously updating The Political Machine 2024 to reflect real-time political shifts and developments. This dedication ensures that players remain engaged and informed while crafting their campaign strategies. Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy the new features included in this update!

notes.title: Pre-Election Update Released
notes.content:
Final major update to political strategy simulation updates issues and voter enthusiasm to give most accurate model yet 

Stardock Entertainment released the final major update for its political strategy/simulation game, The Political Machine 2024 today.  The new version adjusts the top political issues along with voter enthusiasm as of October 2024. 

“We are seeing a lot of movement on voter enthusiasm,” said Brad Wardell, CEO of Stardock Entertainment.  “The election is solidifying around a handful of key issues such as inflation, abortion and the border.” 

For the enthusiasm update, Stardock has attempted to simulate the effect early voting is having on turn-out and how it might affect the election. 

“It’s been challenging to have the game’s underlying model factor in voting that occurs over multiple days,” said Wardell. “But I think we are getting there.  We will see how close we are soon enough.” 

As for the game’s much-celebrated deep-election simulation features, where AI Donald Trump runs against AI Kamala Harris in pure sim mode, the outcome remains too close to call but with a slight edge for Trump. 

“The model continues to call out North Carolina as a state we should be keeping an eye on.  We are still investigating why it thinks North Carolina and not Pennsylvania is the linchpin state,” said Wardell. 

View the full changelog here.

notes.title: v1.12 Update: Adds J.D. Vance, Recent Real-World Issues, More Customization
notes.content:
J.D. Vance, real-world issues, new custom candidate body parts, and improved gameplay experiences

The Political Machine 2024 continues to evolve with this update, bringing several new updates that include the addition of J. D. Vance as Donald Trump’s running mate, the introduction of timely real-world issues such as Trump’s Assassination Attempt, and expanded customization options for creating unique candidates. This update also includes various gameplay improvements to ensure a smoother and more engaging political simulation experience.

View the Full Changelog

New Candidate: J. D. Vance Joins the Race
In a move that mirrors recent real-world political developments, J. D. Vance, Donald Trump’s newly nominated running mate, has been added to the game. This addition allows players to explore new strategies and dynamics as they navigate the complex world of American politics.

Addressing Real-World Issues
One of the standout features of this update is the inclusion of new issues that reflect current events and debates. Players can now tackle topics such as Trump’s Assassination Attempt, Biden’s Debate Performance, Addressing Political Extremism, Israel-Palestine Peace, and the Foreign Social Media Ban. These additions ensure that The Political Machine 2024 remains relevant and thought-provoking, offering players a chance to engage with the pressing issues of our time.

New Body Parts for Custom Candidate Creation
For those who love to personalize their candidates, the update brings a variety of new custom candidate body parts. From bowties and various head shapes to an array of noses, hairstyles, and facial expressions, the customization options are more extensive than ever. Whether you want your candidate to sport a scholarly combed side hairdo or a distinctive egg-shaped head, the possibilities are now broader.

Enhanced Gameplay Experience
The update isn't just about new faces. A series of bug fixes and improvements have been implemented to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience. AI adjustments, AI vs AI speedup, balance changes, and quality of life enhancements are all part of this update, making your political campaigns more engaging and realistic.


The Political Machine 2024 v1.12 update is a testament to the game's commitment to staying current and engaging. With the addition of J. D. Vance, timely new issues, and a host of gameplay improvements, players can look forward to an enriched political simulation experience. As real-world events continue to unfold, The Political Machine 2024 remains a compelling platform for exploring the intricacies of American politics.

notes.title: The Political Machine 2024 v1.11 Now Available
notes.content:
The Political Machine 2024 v1.11 brings Game Balance Changes and Quality of Life Adjustments

As the political landscape continues to evolve, so does The Political Machine 2024. The latest update, v1.11, is here, and it’s packed with changes that directly address player feedback, game quality, and balancing. Here’s a look at the highlights of this update.

Check out the full changelog here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740336/07ddd8ca76f214e709464cb0e9e69303ee8622a1.jpg

Core Improvements
The core of this update focuses on refining the gameplay experience and ensuring a balanced and fair political battleground. One of the standout changes is the enhancement of the No Card Mode, which now includes War Room and Endorsement functionalities. This adds a new layer of strategy without overwhelming players with cards, catering to those who prefer a streamlined experience.

Balance changes have also been a major focus. To curb overpowered strategies and excessive funds, significant adjustments have been made. Notably, there is now a War Room usage limit per turn, and the cost of operatives increases with each purchase. These changes promote a more diverse and balanced approach to political campaigning.

In addition to these gameplay changes, the custom candidate creator has received a substantial update. Players can now enjoy creating even more unique candidates with the addition of new parts, including various body, head, ear, eyebrow, nose, hair, glasses, eye, and mouth options. This enhancement allows for greater personalization and creativity.

Improved No Card Mode
The No Card Mode has seen significant improvements. War Room and Endorsements functionalities are now integrated, offering more strategic depth without the complexity of managing cards. Additionally, Political Capital and Political Capital Buildings have been re-enabled to account for Endorsements usage, ensuring a balanced approach.

Balance Changes
The balance changes aim to limit overpowered War Room strategies and manage funds more effectively. The War Room now has a usage limit per turn, and operative costs increase by 10% with each purchase. Various Political Action Cards have also seen their fund gains and boosts decreased, making it more challenging to accumulate excessive funds and promoting a more balanced financial landscape within the game.

Event Adjustments
Several events have been adjusted to ensure a more balanced gameplay experience. For instance, the Big Pharma Offer's accepting fund gain has been decreased, and the Mysterious Photographer's base cost option spend has been increased. These changes ensure that events provide a balanced challenge and reward structure.

New Custom Candidate Creator Parts
The custom candidate creator has received a substantial update, allowing players to further personalize their candidates with a variety of new parts. These enhancements allow for greater creativity and personalization, making the game even more engaging and enjoyable.

Gameplay Adjustments and Quality of Life Improvements
Several gameplay adjustments and quality of life improvements have been made to enhance the overall experience. Players can now seamlessly transition from a Primaries win to a Presidential game. The issue where randomized issues persisted between games has been fixed, and the War Room tutorial has been updated to reflect the new changes. Additionally, events that give cards will no longer appear in No Card Mode, and the HQ visual duplication glitch has been fixed.


The Political Machine 2024 v1.11 update is a testament to the developers’ commitment to listening to player feedback and continuously improving the game. Whether you’re a seasoned political strategist or a newcomer, these changes promise a more balanced, engaging, and enjoyable experience. So, gear up and dive back into the political fray with these exciting updates!

notes.title: Now Available: v1.1 Command & Conquer Update
notes.content:
v1.1 Command & Conquer Update introduces the War Room & Enhanced Endorsement System 

Today, Stardock Entertainment released the v1.1 Command & Conquer Update for its political strategy game, The Political Machine 2024. This update includes the introduction of the War Room, a revamped Endorsement System, and several quality-of-life improvements aimed at enhancing the player experience.

The v1.1 Command & Conquer update introduces two major features designed to deepen the strategic gameplay for both new and existing players. The War Room allows candidates to spend campaign funds to purchase Operative Cards from a market. These cards, which can be played at any time without additional costs, offer various tactical advantages to influence the campaign's outcome.

Additionally, the Endorsement System has been overhauled. Candidates can now spend Political Capital to secure endorsements from 12 unique groups, each providing immediate benefits. This new approach removes the randomness of previous systems, allowing for more deliberate and strategic endorsement acquisition. Together, these features add a new layer of strategy, enabling players to dynamically adjust their campaign tactics.

"With the Command & Conquer update, we wanted to give players more control over their campaign strategies," said Brad Wardell, CEO of Stardock Entertainment. "The War Room and the enhanced Endorsement System provide new ways to influence the game, making each playthrough more unique and engaging."

For more information on the v1.1 Command & Conquer update, view the full changelog here.

notes.title: NOW OUT: The Presidential Pioneers v1.01 Update for The Political Machine 2024
notes.content:
The Presidential Pioneers v1.01 Update brings New Candidates, Mac Support, and Game Quality Improvements

Today we released a significant update for their strategy game, The Political Machine 2024. This update introduces an array of past presidential candidates, extends compatibility to macOS, and implements various bug fixes and balance adjustments.

View the full changelog here

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2512090/The_Political_Machine_2024/

New Faces in the Political Arena
The latest update enriches the game's roster with notable figures from American political history:

Democrats: Players can now lead campaigns for Democrats like Bill Clinton, Barack Obama, John Kerry, Jimmy Carter, Al Gore, or Martin O’Malley, each offering unique strategic opportunities.

Independents: The game broadens its appeal with independents such as Ross Perot, Ralph Nader, and Jill Stein, providing alternative strategies for reaching the White House.

Republicans: The Republican lineup is enhanced with Ronald Reagan, Mitt Romney, George W. Bush, George Bush Sr., Dwight D. Eisenhower, and Richard Nixon, adding depth and variety to the gameplay.

Mac Version Launch
With this update, The Political Machine 2024 is now available on macOS, allowing Mac users to engage in the electoral challenge. This update aims to bring the game to a wider audience, ensuring that Mac users can enjoy the same detailed and immersive gameplay experience as PC users.

Bug Fixes and Balance Changes
The update addresses several bugs and makes balance changes to improve gameplay fluidity and fairness. These adjustments were made in response to community feedback and are designed to enhance player experience by providing a more stable and equitable game environment.


This update significantly enhances The Political Machine 2024 by broadening the playable character pool and extending platform availability to Mac users. The inclusion of a diverse range of historical political figures allows players to explore various campaign strategies and adds educational value by highlighting key personalities and their political ideologies.

notes.title: Dev Journal #6: Candidate Call
notes.content:
Thank you for everyone who’s supported us since we released on May 2nd! Just because we released doesn’t mean the updates are over though! We have been seeing your feedback and are addressing points from it as we speak. 

We’d like to use this space again to show what’s coming up on our update on May 16th!

First off we want to say we have heard the requests to add more candidates. In response, we have been working hard to return a handful of candidates from previous iterations back into the fray in this update! As a teaser, some of the Democrats out of the set of returners this update are Jimmy Carter and John Kerry!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740336/cef868e706ddcbc895fb599de5032c4e56cbc321.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740336/5dae35063f28dee96e3f8a4f663e43506cb76117.png

And that’s just a small tease - look forward to additional Republicans, Democrats, and Independents that are to return as well. There will also be a couple of new candidates that are being introduced for the first time!

In this update we have also added the ability to edit and save your custom candidate’s titles and descriptions! Seeing what people have been able to do with our customizer on the Workshop has been amazing and we wanted to give players a tool to further personalize their candidates.

These titles and descriptions are also saved when you upload a candidate on the workshop! For example, take this candidate made - Macy Appler.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740336/7541c92e966734ff4dec8589f6b2bce757fdd32e.png

Macy is no longer is confined to just being a Presidential Hopeful and can express herself as a Mac and Cheese Enthusiast. As silly as this candidate sounds, the theming was specific because I needed a transition point for the next feature to announce:

Speaking of Mac, we have heard discussion posts wondering about support for the platform. I’m proud to say from this this update on May 16th onward The Political Machine 2024 will also be able to be playable on Mac!

Our candidate work won’t be done with just this update alone, we’d like to hear your thoughts on what candidates you would like to see in a future update! Post it in replies, discussion forums and chat channels for who you would like to see.

We’d like to thank everyone again for your support on The Political Machine 2024 release and post-release!

notes.title: Dev Journal #4: What's The Issue?
notes.content:
The Political Machine launches May 2, 2024


The past couple weeks we’ve been talking through the major features introduced for The Political Machine 2024. With all the new major features covered, we wanted to now highlight an important part of the process in developing this series every 4 years, issue updates!

First we figure out nationally what are the generalized current top issues as a basis of understanding. We do this by looking at a good number of national research polls and news outlets across the political spectrum.

Next, we break down a generalized top issue into relevant topics. For example, one of the top issues for the 2024 election is about Economy. As much as we can make an issue about the direct thing, it is very much nuanced and can be broken down into more issues. For example Economy as a wider topic can be broken down into “Addressing Inflation”, “Higher Minimum Wage”, “Individual Tax Cuts”, and more.

Then we apply importance and positions of these issues to states to give each state a more unique identity. Based on the breaking down of the bigger issue subject, we refine it by looking at local news sources and state government webpages. 

For example, we take a general issue like the Environment and we apply certain broken down topics more meaningfully. For example, states like Florida and Hawaii will care more about Disaster Preparedness because of the higher frequency of natural disasters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740336/1ad32ac4ae9021b917399f9603f9ed5bd818a883.png 

Meanwhile, Maryland and other northeastern coastal states with less extreme weather events would care more about Marine Environmental Protection. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740336/3d15cdbe5ad8ec9ca8f3a62dc684a1ef6b87d734.png 

And since California are leading in ESG legislation early this year, that topic as well as Green Jobs are a more prominent as a response.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740336/e722dec297b862493546cf81b16eacabd1c2a891.png 

Finally we extensively review the issue updates by running it through internally and with our playtest team. Once the play testers on all sides of the political spectrum sign off and a general consensus is reached, we know our work is complete.

Don’t most people in the country care about the same things? That is true, but if we did that without regionally differing and breaking down the subjects of major top issues, the states would all have the same issue topic strategy. That being said, there will be issues that show up in most states as we have to be sure our polling makes sense and is representative of each of the top general issues. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740336/127f2470f7e6afc4eb83e55c25098b964b994017.png
The reason why we set apart states with different but similar topics is so that way players are incentivized to talk about more issues during their Primaries or presidential campaign in terms of gameplay. It also sets more room for players to personalize their stances for custom candidates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740336/14d5112b71d644ff392320c8447ae239d668381e.png 

One of the great things about The Political Machine 2024 is that you can talk and raise awareness on any issue you choose and see how the affects the rest of the country. By talking on issues in states, you raise your issue score, which is important to the factor of boosting polling.

We’d like to say thanks to those who have given feedback thus far for us to improve this game and we encourage everyone to keep sending in their suggestions! 

Please look forward to the full release of The Political Machine 2024 on May 2, 2024!

notes.title: Steam Playtest Now Available
notes.content:
Pre-order Customers can now Participate in the Steam Playtest 

Stardock announced that the latest iteration of its hit political strategy series, The Political Machine 2024 entered its playtest phase today. The game, which allows players to simulate a run for the American presidency, features an updated roster of politicians and introduces new gameplay mechanics that reflect the ever-evolving landscape of U.S. politics. 

The Political Machine 2024 allows players to step into the shoes of current political figures like Joe Biden, Donald Trump, Elizabeth Warren, and Nikki Haley, or create a fully customized candidate through the game's character customization system.  

Building on the series’ robust political simulation model, which has been recognized by major news outlets for its accuracy in predicting previous election outcomes, the 2024 edition adds some much-requested features. Play testers will have the exclusive opportunity to experience these new additions in the 2024 version, including: 

 Primaries: Players can choose to run against other candidates to win their party’s nomination for President. 
 Debates: Candidates will face each other in a simulated debate on the issues of the day. 
 PACs (Political Action Cards): Players can use these to bolster their campaign or thwart their opponents. 

At its core, The Political Machine 2024 is a sophisticated simulator, where each state's political leanings and issues are meticulously researched and updated to reflect the latest demographic data and current political climate. Players with a deep understanding of the real-world political landscape will discover a game that rewards strategic thinking and political savvy. 

"At Stardock, we value player feedback as a cornerstone of game development. By inviting fans into the game prior to release, we foster a collaborative environment where their input directly shapes the final, polished experience." said Brad Wardell, Creative Director of Stardock.  

Stardock invites players to explore the nuances between candidates within the same party, appreciating the ideological spectrum that differentiates a Democrat like Bernie Sanders from one like Dean Phillips, or a Republican like Ron Desantis from Ted Cruz.  

Pre-order customers of The Political Machine 2024 can now gain access to the game ahead of its full release. The Political Machine 2024 remains available for pre-order and includes a free pre-order bonus, the 'Cabinet of Curiosities' DLC.

notes.title: Steam Playtest Coming Soon and Release Date Info
notes.content:
An update on the game release date and announcing the playtest

The game was originally slated to release later this month Feb 2024, however after much deliberation we have made the decision to delay the game to late Spring 2024. This decision was not made lightly.

Due to changing dates in the political landscape, we felt our release best aligns with the late Spring date. Beyond that, the general scope of the original project has increased for the better, with a visual overhaul, new features and more. However, to ensure the best possible experience we wanted time to fine tune these new features, while also collecting proper community feedback.

So with that, we're here to announce that The Political Machine 2024 is gearing up to enter its Steam Playtest Phase soon! This will be a chance for pre-purchasers to dive into the heart of political strategy, make their mark, and help us shape the game into the ultimate political battleground.

Your insights and feedback are invaluable. Help us fine-tune the gameplay, mechanics, and features to ensure the best possible experience for all players.


Stay tuned for more details, thank you for your support!

Stardock announced the latest iteration of its hit political strategy series, The Political Machine 2024 today. The game, which allows players to simulate a run for the American presidency, features an updated roster of politicians and introduces new gameplay mechanics that reflect the ever-evolving landscape of U.S. politics. 

The Political Machine 2024 allows players to step into the shoes of current political figures like Joe Biden, Donald Trump, Bernie Sanders, and Ron DeSantis, or create a completely customized candidate with the game’s in-depth creation workshop.  

Building on the series’ robust political simulation model, which has been recognized by major news outlets for its accuracy in predicting previous election outcomes, the 2024 edition adds some much-requested features including: 

 Primaries: Players can choose to run against other candidates to win their party’s nomination for President. 
 Debates: Candidates will face each other in a simulated debate on the issues of the day. 
 PACs: Political Action Cards that players can use to bolster their campaign or thwart their opponents. 

At its core, The Political Machine 2024 is a sophisticated simulator, where each state's political leanings and issues are meticulously researched and updated to reflect the latest demographic data and current political climate. Players with a deep understanding of the real-world political landscape will discover a game that rewards strategic thinking and political savvy. 

"The Political Machine has always been about capturing the spirit and complexity of the American election cycle," said Brad Wardell, Creative Director of Stardock. "With the 2024 edition, we're bringing even more depth to the experience with new features that mirror the real-world tactics used in political campaigns." 

Stardock invites players to explore the nuances between candidates within the same party, appreciating the ideological spectrum that differentiates a Democrat like Bernie Sanders from one like Bill Clinton, or a Republican like Ronald Reagan from Mitt Romney.
